title: Differential bus transceiver (RS-422/RS-485), 3-state driver and receiver

sources.document: TI SN65176B/SN75176B datasheet SLLS101I (July 1985, revised August 2025)

pins.name: A
pins.text: bus pin, non-inverting: driver output and receiver input

pins.name: B
pins.text: bus pin, inverting: driver output and receiver input

functions.text: while DE is high, A follows D; while DE is low it floats.
while DE is high, B is the opposite of D; while DE is low it floats.
while /RE is low: R is high when A - B >= +0.2 V, low when A - B <= -0.2 V, unknown in between and with the inputs open; R floats while /RE is high.

electrical.notes: Driver: IOH -60 mA, IOL 60 mA. Receiver output: IOH -0.4 mA, IOL 8 mA. Receiver input hysteresis 50 mV typ, input resistance 12 kohm min. Bus pins -7 V to +12 V. Supply 4.75-5.25 V (pages 4, 6).

notes: The card drawing names the pins EB (pin 3, drive enable), D (pin 4), EY~ (pin 2, receive enable), Y (pin 1), B and B~ (pins 6, 7). The datasheet gives no minimum delays.
